<!-- 说明 API、数据库、配置或依赖变化，以及迁移、升级操作或回滚方式；没有写「无 / None」。 / Describe API, database, configuration, or dependency changes and any migration, upgrade, or rollback steps; write “None” if not applicable. -->

## 提交前确认 / Checklist

- [ ] 改动聚焦，没有混入无关格式化或生成物。 / Changes are focused and exclude unrelated formatting or generated files.
- [ ] 已检查改动并说明验证结果，按需补充测试与文档。 / I reviewed the changes, reported verification results, and updated tests and documentation where needed.
- [ ] 未提交密钥、真实用户数据或私人部署信息。 / No secrets, real user data, or private deployment details are included.
- [ ] 权限、组织隔离与 AI 人工确认流程保持有效；不涉及则勾选。 / Permission, tenant isolation, and human confirmation checks remain effective, or are unaffected.
- [ ] 我有权提交内容，第三方来源与许可已保留。 / I have the right to submit this contribution and have preserved third-party attribution and licenses.
- [ ] 已阅读贡献指南。 / I have read CONTRIBUTING.md.
